instruction: A cathedral-like clockwork factory: interlocking brass gears of every size turning in mesh, leather drive belts spinning on overhead shafts, steam pipes with hissing relief valves, a glowing furnace mouth, catwalks and riveted columns, pressure gauges with trembling needles, a great flywheel, chain hoists, and shafts of light through high sooty windows.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Clockwork Factory Hall. A cathedral-like clockwork factory: interlocking brass gears of every size turning in mesh, leather drive belts spinning on overhead shafts, steam pipes with hissing relief valves, a glowing furnace mouth, catwalks and riveted columns, pressure gauges with trembling needles, a great flywheel, chain hoists, and shafts of light through high sooty windows. Style: brass steampunk. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
